author: Julie Pierantoni
text: Sorry you’re having difficulty. I’ve used libre CGM 5 years and only had a few sensor issues. My parents age 87 and 81 also use libre with great success.  Sounds like you got a bad batch.

author: Paula Hess
text: I had the same problem. It seems that quality has gone downhill since the recall. Abbott will only replace so many before they say you have reached your replacement limit. I am trying Dexcom to see if itnis any better. Each sensor comes with a cover to help hold it on. Drawbck is they last 10 days not 14
